description: This source file implements the StreamPubSubImpl class which provides an internal implementation of the IStreamPubSub interface for managing stream producer and consumer subscriptions within Orleans streaming. It acts as a facade over explicit and implicit pub/sub mechanisms, coordinating registration, unregistration, and subscription management.

classes.name: StreamPubSubImpl
classes.description: An internal class implementing IStreamPubSub that manages stream subscriptions and acts as a facade over explicit and implicit pub/sub implementations within Orleans streaming.

methods.name: StreamPubSubImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes explicit and implicit pub/sub components with null checks.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for the specified stream, combining explicit and implicit registration results.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from the specified stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer to the stream, choosing between implicit and explicit mechanisms based on whether the consumer is implicit.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from the stream, selecting implicit or explicit unregistration based on the consumer type.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers registered for a given stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers registered for a given stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer, combining implicit and explicit subscriptions.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription identifier, choosing implicit or explicit creation based on consumer type.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulty, selecting between implicit and explicit based on the subscription id and stream.
